description: HR-52 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) office serving the Hathin sub-division in the Palwal district of Haryana. It operates under the supervision of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations and driving permit issuance for the local region.
address: Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA-cum-SDM Office), Hathin, District Palwal, Haryana
